sources.dataset_name: World Bank Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet), monthly historical workbook
sources.purpose: Global upstream commodity-price research proxy only

license.name: CC BY 4.0 with World Bank dataset terms
license.notes: World Bank-produced open datasets default to CC BY 4.0 unless specifically labelled otherwise; dataset-specific exceptions remain fail-closed.

sources.attribution: World Bank Prospects Group, World Bank Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet), accessed on the snapshot retrieval date.
conceptual_limitations: Commodity prices are upstream world-market prices rather than household transaction prices.
The latest historical workbook does not preserve the first-published vintage of each historical observation.
The workbook cannot enter an ARM-L information set until release-time archives are independently preserved and backtested.

sources.authority: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
sources.dataset_name: FAO Food Price Index, nominal monthly indices
sources.purpose: International food commodity-price research proxy only

license.name: CC BY 4.0 under FAO Statistical Database Terms of Use
license.notes: FAO statistical database reuse requires the prescribed attribution and indication of modifications.

sources.attribution: FAO. FAO Food Price Index. Accessed on the snapshot retrieval date. Licence: CC BY 4.0.
conceptual_limitations: The FFPI measures international commodity quotations and does not measure national household retail prices.
The current CSV is a revised history and does not itself preserve historical first-published vintages.
A release date for the current snapshot does not establish the publication date of every historical row.

sources.dataset_name: Weekly Oil Bulletin price developments, 2005 onwards
sources.purpose: EU consumer fuel-price research proxy only

license.name: European Commission reuse policy under Decision 2011/833/EU
license.notes: Reuse is authorised subject to source acknowledgement and any dataset-specific exceptions.

sources.attribution: Source: European Commission, Directorate-General for Energy, Weekly Oil Bulletin; changes by ARMILAR are identified.
conceptual_limitations: Coverage is limited to EU countries and petroleum products.
Fuel prices are relevant mainly to CP07 and parts of CP04 and cannot substitute for complete category prices.
The current history workbook does not prove the first-published value available on each historical date.

sources.dataset_name: Owner-occupied housing price index, quarterly data (prc_hpi_ooq)
sources.purpose: OOH sensitivity analysis only; never a direct HFCE imputed-rent replacement

license.name: Eurostat free reuse policy
license.notes: Eurostat data may be reused with acknowledgement unless an identified third-party exception applies.

sources.attribution: Source: Eurostat, dataset prc_hpi_ooq; modifications and retrieval date identified by ARMILAR.
conceptual_limitations: OOHPI follows a net-acquisitions framework and is not equivalent to HFCE imputed rent.
The source is admitted only for the constitutionally required OOH sensitivity analysis.
The current API response does not preserve first-published historical vintages or exact release timestamps.
